items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: When he took over to Levita I always said that too, you see.

ctx.x: You see, after- You didn't work with the Luciana Shakers?
No, I said it was the Luciana Shakers, because I always know the only band as the Luciana Shakers. When he took over to Levita I always said that too, you see.
